name: NewsBlur
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For NewsBlur, self-host a feed reader with training filters, folders, and full-text search. The hard boundary is hosted convenience, native apps, story intelligence, and community features, plus capture polish, sync, and content partnerships.
